decisions.reason: As a large R&D-active firm in a growing industry with organisational slack, it is likely to retain this camera because it is close to the core business and there is no clear sign of performance below aspiration.

The modular navigation camera fits the firm's established capabilities and future direction, so under bounded rationality and with available slack management would likely continue it absent evidence of a shortfall.

Although somewhat broader than the core camera offer, this sensor suite still builds on existing competences and a resource-rich firm would usually keep it while learning unless results clearly disappoint.

This miniaturized LiDAR sensor matches the firm's miniaturisation strategy, but the weaker website presence suggests more uncertainty, so it has a higher drop risk even though slack and strategic fit still favor keeping it.
